out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Initial terror on returning toward the car/body; then attention drawn into 'peace and love' that 'securely embraced' her.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described as a 'swirling tunnel' with 'magnetic motion within the molecules' facilitating a 'dimensional shift'.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified escort as 'Archangel Mich'l'; later encountered 'Yehoshua (Jeshua/Jesus)' and 'Mother Mary' and an instructor named 'Raf'l'.
arrival.other_being_detail: Also mentions 'Ascended Masters', 'Enlightened Beings', and 'a couple of other students' in a 'classroom'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Classroom; multiple rooms including one with a 'large fluffy chair' and another with 'many drawers on the wall'; an 'etheric screen' showing information; 'metallic type of energy/material'; hill with grass and flowers.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Return framed as necessary to avoid 'too much physical damage from the coma' and to return to do the 'work'/deliver messages; also reassured she would return to continue her education.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told her purpose of returning is 'to be a portal' refining fear into Love; bring 'Magnetic Tools' teachings; produce a 'manuscript' and 'presentations'; help others align with Source/Unconditional Love.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motor vehicle collision; crushed under steering wheel; multiple pelvic fractures and six ribs; blood filled lungs; 10-day coma.

person_demographics.occupation: Chiropractor (stated future: 'I will be a small town Chiropractor')

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Healing 'chair' experience; 'classroom' instruction; past-life memory/identification as Mary Magdalene; encounter with Mother Mary; 'etheric screen' information viewing.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above accident → presence/guide and ascent → brilliant Light → tunnel → encounters/teaching environments → return prompted by need to wake from coma and neurologist calling her back.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: After return: 'Seeing in both dimensions left some confusion' and 'the other Beings were still visible to me' while in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Extensive 'classroom' instruction on geometric/physics healing tools; 'metallic type of energy/material'; DNA 'encoding' by Light; identification as 'Mary (Magdalene)' in past life with Yehoshua; post-return dual-perception and perceiving 'thoughts' floating in the air; report of speaking about photosynthesis while in coma and claiming to be a tomato plant.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself rising above the accident… I realized that I was out of my body floating above the accident.” / “A blinding magnetic brilliant Light focused on my forehead…” / “The Light formulated into a swirling tunnel…” / “His reply was, Archangel Mich'l.” / “Standing on my left was Yehoshua… ‘I see that in you too now Mary (Magdalene), don’t forget!’” / “Anlee, come back… It’s time to wake up… Time to come back…” / “I don’t want to.”
